assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and the quantum account of primordial structure transformed cosmology and made sharply testable links between fundamental physics and the sky.
assessment.attribution: Guth initiated inflation, Linde developed its durable realizations, and Mukhanov supplied the decisive quantum theory of primordial perturbations.
assessment.maturity: CMB and large-scale-structure observations give this framework exceptional empirical standing, though not every microphysical realization is established.
uncertainties: The underlying inflationary mechanism remains unidentified.
Some predicted signatures, notably primordial gravitational waves, have not been confirmed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Precision CMB anisotropy maps converted cosmology into a quantitatively constrained science and revealed the seeds of cosmic structure.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Page were central to precision microwave-background mapping, while Puget made foundational observational contributions to the relevant sky measurements.
assessment.maturity: The results have been repeatedly confirmed and remain a central empirical foundation of modern cosmology.
uncertainties: Credit is necessarily diffuse across several major satellite and ground-based collaborations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric and topological quantum phases exposed a profound physical content of quantum mechanics with consequences across modern physics.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov introduced the experimentally consequential electromagnetic-potential effect, and Berry identified the general adiabatic geometric phase.
assessment.maturity: Both effects are extensively observed and have become indispensable conceptual and experimental tools.
uncertainties: The two effects are distinct enough that the unity of a single prize formulation requires careful framing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Horizon-scale black-hole imaging is a striking new observational capability and a direct encounter with gravity in its strongest accessible regime.
assessment.attribution: Falcke articulated the observational black-hole-shadow case, Moran was crucial to very-long-baseline radio astronomy, and Doeleman led the realization of the global instrument.
assessment.maturity: Multiple horizon-scale images and continuing analyses establish the method beyond a one-off result.
uncertainties: The images test strong-gravity phenomenology but do not alone uniquely discriminate all alternatives to general relativity.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect introduced a robust new organizing principle for electronic matter.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele provided the defining theoretical prediction, and Molenkamp supplied a landmark experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The phenomena are reproduced broadly and have generated a sustained field of topological quantum materials.
uncertainties: The larger experimental and theoretical lineage makes the boundary of individual credit difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Baryon acoustic oscillations supplied a powerful standard ruler and an unusually clean observational route to the expansion history of the Universe.
assessment.attribution: Eisenstein, Cole, and Percival were central to recognizing and measuring the galaxy-survey signal.
assessment.maturity: Independent surveys have confirmed BAO and made it a standard precision-cosmology observable.
uncertainties: The discovery rests on large collaborations, so a three-person attribution is intrinsically incomplete.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have achieved a major advance in timekeeping and enable sensitive probes of gravitation and fundamental physics.
assessment.attribution: Katori originated the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept, and Ye made defining experimental advances and applications.
assessment.maturity: Their extraordinary performance is independently established and already supports a broad precision-measurement program.
uncertainties: The ultimate scientific consequences of the new precision, beyond metrology itself, are still developing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Gauge/gravity duality has remade theoretical work on quantum gravity, black holes, and strongly coupled quantum systems.
assessment.attribution: Maldacena formulated the correspondence, with Witten and Polyakov providing essential conceptual and field-theoretic foundations.
assessment.maturity: Its intellectual and technical impact is immense and persistent across several fields.
uncertainties: No direct empirical confirmation establishes the correspondence as a description of nature.
The proper boundary of credit extends beyond three people.
